name: qrepo
description: Syncs a qrepo workspace on its own, holds unusual changes, settles conflicts with you, and shows where each line came from.

commands.title: Compare conflict with the other device's version
Finish merge (my edits are the resolution)

qrepo.path.description: The qr executable. Empty: `qr` on PATH.

qrepo.autoSync.description: Sync on a timer and after saves. Off: only `qrepo: Sync now`.

qrepo.idleDelay.description: Seconds after a save before syncing.

qrepo.device.description: This device's name in history and hovers (qr config device). Empty: leave as it is.

qrepo.mergeRules.description: Merge edits that only touch (adjacent lines, both appending) instead of asking; both devices' lines are kept, the other device's first. Sets qr config merge-rules for this folder.

qrepo.hover.description: Show on hover which device and checkpoint wrote a line.

qrepo.hold.deletions.description: Hold a deleted file for a look before syncing it.

qrepo.hold.binary.description: Hold a changed binary file for a look before syncing it.

qrepo.hold.removedFraction.description: Hold a text file that lost more than this share of its lines…

qrepo.hold.removedLines.description: …when that is at least this many lines.
